__descriptions__.context_size: Number of tokens in the context to be passed to the auto-encoder
__descriptions__.max_positions: Maximum position tokens in an input midi file
__descriptions__.max_bars: Maximum bars in an input midi file
__descriptions__.max_bars_per_context: Add <bos> and <eos> to each context if contexts are limited to a certain number of bars
__descriptions__.max_contexts_per_file: Maximum contexts in an input midi file after encoding
__descriptions__.num_workers: Number of workers to load the dataset
__descriptions__.pin_memory: Whether to use pinned memory for loading data
__descriptions__.train_val_test_split: Split percentages for the dataset (train, validation, test)
